statements.text: The rapid pace—which appears to be accelerating—reflects, in large part, the construction of data centers and the immense demand for the AI-related equipment and software that fill them.

statements.text: We don’t know the extent to which the economy will benefit from the AI buildout. Yet it seems inevitable that what is now called “AI investment” will soon be called just “investment.” Even so, new opportunities for the economy introduce new challenges for policymakers. We at the Fed are monitoring the implications for inflation and the labor market.
